provenance: Original fictional RelayMind scenario. Company, customer, ports, routes and orders are invented.

sources.title: Carrier plan, 14 October
sources.text: Approved: ship order HB-O201 (40 refrigerated pallets for Coldline Foods) via Route A through Port North. Depart Thursday, deliver Friday.

sources.title: Coldline Foods delivery terms
sources.text: Any change to a confirmed delivery date must be communicated to Coldline Foods at least 24 hours in advance. Refrigerated cargo must stay at or below 4 C. No penalty amount is defined for a one-day delay.

sources.title: Port North closure notice, 16 October
sources.text: Port North is closed Thursday to Saturday for crane maintenance. Bookings through Port North on those days are cancelled by the port.

sources.title: Revised carrier plan, 16 October
sources.text: Approved replacement: ship HB-O201 via Route B through Port South. Depart Thursday, deliver Saturday (one day later). Tell Coldline Foods before confirming any delivery date.

decisions.text: Ship HB-O201 via Route A (Port North); depart Thursday, deliver Friday.
Ship HB-O201 via Route B (Port South); depart Thursday, deliver Saturday (+1 day). Notify Coldline Foods before confirming.
decisions.reason: Port North closed Thursday to Saturday

tasks.title: Book carrier slot on Route A (Port North)
Confirm Friday delivery with Coldline Foods
Book carrier slot on Route B (Port South)

procedure.name: Harbor route-change review
steps: Every step cites the current approved route decision, a source or a task by ID.
Plans made under a superseded route are history only; recompute bookings for the current route.
Tasks implementing a superseded route get an explicit proposed action (cancel, pause or replace).
Customer-facing date changes follow the contract notice rule; never confirm a date that is not approved.
Do not invent penalties, costs or owners that the sources do not state.

messages.content: Plan for HB-O201: Route A through Port North, depart Thursday, Friday delivery to Coldline Foods. Dispatch books the slot; account management confirms Friday.

episodes.summary: On 14 October the team planned HB-O201 via Route A (Port North) for Friday delivery: book the Route A slot (hb-task-book-route-a), then confirm Friday with Coldline Foods (hb-task-confirm-friday).

acceptance.question: May we confirm Friday?
acceptance.expected: No: v1 is superseded; Saturday needs customer notice first (contract).
